occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: The operational handbook lacked a section on promoting indoor play during extreme weather conditions.

Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: There was sufficient evidence found during the DFPS investigation to show that the operation's criteria for extreme weather conditions were not followed when children were allowed to play outdoors for over 45 minutes during excessive heat.

Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: Operation did not have a written operational policy for extreme weather in parent handbook at time of investigation inspection. An updated policy was shared with parents.

Written Operational Policies - Criteria for Extreme Weather: Operational policies were reviewed and are missing the following information:    (18)(F) Outdoor play weather criteria,  (23)(a) how parents may access minimum standards online,  (23)(c) how parents may access HHS website,  (26)(b) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness of issues regarding child abuse and neglect,  (26)(c) Methods for increasing employee and parent awareness ofprevention techniques for child abuse and neglect,  (26)(d) Strategies for coordination between the center and appropriate community organizations,  (26)(e) Actions that the parent of a child who is a victim of abuse or neglect should take to obtain assistance and intervention,  (28) Information on vaccine-preventable diseases for employees and,  (30) Procedures for supporting inclusive services to children with special care needs.
